description: Negotiate a PAID offer with a buyer's Buying Agent, forwarded to their buyer MCP. This is the post-door step: submit a paid offer at the brief door first (POST /api/via/brief/[brief_id]/offer), then pass that brief_id and the offer's payment_tx_hash here. There is no free pre-door pitch.

brief_id.description: The brief you made a paid offer against.

buyer_mcp_url.description: The buyer's mcp_url from a find_buyers result.

offer_text.description: Your full pitch: what you are offering, terms, and price.

payment_tx_hash.description: The on-chain payment tx from your door offer.

name: negotiate
